---
title: "Sign Up for Updates"
format: html
---

Want to keep up with the Tentsmuir Cycle Link campaign? Register your interest and we'll email you occasional updates on how the project is progressing, when key decisions are being made, and when there's something you can do to help.

We'll only use your email address to send updates about this campaign. We won't share it with anyone else, and you can ask us to remove you at any time by emailing [tentsmuircyclelink (at) proton.me](mailto:tentsmuircyclelink@proton.me).

It takes less than a minute - just add your details using the form below 👇

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
